tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bu slob rnams la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yon mchod rnams la spring ba/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sems can spyi dang*/ sgos bod skad smra ba thams cad la phan par bsams nas hor nang du 'ong*/ nged 'bod mkhan la yon bdag chen po shin tu dges/ 'phags pa spun 'di 'dra ba'i chung ba nas khrid nas 'khor dang bcas pa 'ong ba de nged la bsams pa yin/ khyod mgos ngo bltas pa yin/ gzhan tsho rkang pas ngo bltas pa yin/ khyod ngas bos pa yin/ gzhan tsho skrag nas 'ong ba yin/ de ngas mi shes pa e yin/ 'phags pa spun gyis sngar yang bod kyi chos ni shes par 'dug da dung yang 'phags pas bod chos slobs/ phyag na rdo rjes hor yig dang hor skad slobs/ ngas mi chos kyis bskyangs/ khyed kyis lha chos kyis bskyangs na shākya mu ne'i bstan pa yang phyi'i rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun chad khyab par mi 'gro ba e yin gsungs so// rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' 'di spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sgos dkon mchog gsum la shin tu gus/ khrims lugs bzang pos 'khor thams cad legs par skyong zhing*/ khyad par du yang nged la gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs la 'dogs par byung*/ khong gi zhal nas/ khyod rang blo bde bar chos shod/ khyed la gang dgos ngas ster ba yin/ khyod bzang po gtong ba ngas shes/ nga bzang por e gtong gnam shes gsungs/ khyad par 'phags pa spun la thugs 'dogs che bar 'dug rang shes khrims lugs 'khur shes na/ rgyal khams thams cad la phan par bya snyam pa'i thugs dgongs bzang po zhig 'dug sgos khyed rang gi mi sde bod rnams la khrims lugs legs par slobs/ skyid du 'jug pa ngas shes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyal po dang rgyal brgyud rnams tshe ring ba'i smon lam/

rim gro la thams cad kyis 'bad par zhu/ skabs don hor 'di'i dmag sde grangs las 'das/ 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad khong gi mnga' ris su 'dug snyam pa'i bsam pa gcig 'dug khong rang dang mthun pa tsho skyid sdug khong rang dang mnyam par byed/ khong la zhe thag pas gang zer la ma nyan na/ ngo bltas pa yin zer ba'i ming gi mi chog pa/ rting brlag par byed pa cig 'dug yu gur gyi rgyal khams 'di yang ma brlag pa'i gong phan du/ mi nor rnams khong gis blangs nas/ yig mkhan/ nor gnyer ba/ bu dga' thams cad khong gis byed/ rgya/ mi nyag sog po la sogs pa ma brlag gong du hor 'dra btang yang ci zer ma nyan pas/ brlag pa'i rting la 'gro sa ma rnyed nas ngo blta dgos byung*/ 'on kyang de rting ci zer nyan pas da lta tha dad so so na bu dga'/ nor gnyer/ dmag dpon/ yig mkhan la sogs pa khong rang gi mi tshan re bskos pa mang*/ 'o skol mi sde ngan la gyong pas thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bros pas thar du re/ thag ring bas mi yong du re/ 'thab thub tu re nas/ g.yo sgyu zol gsum byas pas brlag kyang brlag tha dad so so nas ngo bltas pa'i tsho mang*/ bod ngan la gyong ba'i stobs kyis bran dang g.yog gi bye brag ma gtogs pa/ dpon por bskos pa brgya la re 'ga' tsam las ma mthong*/ bod ngo bltas pa mang yang 'dab nor nyung ba'i stobs kyis/ mi chen tsho rting nas ma mgu ba'i gnad cig gda'/ na ning ni lo 'ga' la stod du dmag song ba med/ ngas bi ri khrid nas ngo bltas/ 'dir shin tu ngo blta legs pas/ stod mnga' ris dbus gtsang ba rnams ngo bltas/ bi ri tha dad tsho yang ngo blta bar yod byas pas/ da bar la dmag ma song ba des phan pa yin te/ stod kyi mi rnams de tshe mi shes te mchis/ de skabs su 'di na mar ngo bltas pa yin kyang*/ 'dab nor legs po ma byas pa dang*/ blo ma gtad pa kun la dmag rgyab nas mi nor thams cad gtor ba de khyed rnams kyis thos te mchis/

dmag rgyab pa de tsho yul btsan/ mi dpa'/ dmag mang*/ go cha sra zhing mda' mkhas pa rnams kyis thub tu re byas pas brlag 'dug mi rnams kyi bsam pa la/ hor kho rang 'u lag dang dmag khral chung*/ gzhan tsho 'u lag dang dmag khral che bsam ste/ gzhan tsho bas hor rang 'u lag dang dmag khral che/ de dang sbyar na gzhan tsho chung bar gda'/ da dung yang ci zer gyi ngag la nyan na/ khyed rnams kyi yul/ sa phyogs kyi mi sde/ so so'i dpon gang yod pa de dpon du bskos/ sa skya pa'i gser yig pa dang dngul yig pa bos la/ nged kyi dar kha che 'di bskos na 'thad pa yin zer ba'i ngo sprod gyis la phar 'gro tshur 'gro'i bang chen pa go chod pa chung*/ de nas dpon gyi ming*/ mi sde'i grangs/ 'dab nor gyi tshad yi ge legs po gsum gyis la/ gcig nged la bskur/ gcig sa skyar zhog gcig rang rang gi dpon gyis zung*/ yang ngo bltas pa 'di yin/ ma bltas pa 'di yin zer ba'i sa ris legs po gyis/ shan ma phyed na ngo ma bltas pa'i zhor la bltas pa tsho yang brlag dogs yod/ sa skya pa'i gser yig pas yul gang yin pa'i dpon dang gros gyis la/ sems can la yang phan par gyis la rang tsho dbang che ma byed/ yul dpon gyis kyang sa skya pa'i gser yig pa dang gros ma byas par rang tshod ma byed/ gros ma byas par rang tshod byed pa khrims la med/ nyes pa la thug na 'di na zhu ba dka'/ der thams cad blo mthun par gyis/ hor gyi khrims lugs byas na legs po 'ong*/ gser yig pa bsu skyel dang zhabs tog legs por gyis/ 'di yang gser yig pa yod pa kun la gzhan 'dri ba'i sngon la ma bros sam 'thab bam/ gser yig pa tsho nyar legs por byas sam/ 'u lag byung ngam/ ngo bltas pa rnams brtan nam byas pa de tsho sngon la 'dri bar 'dug gser yig pa de ma mgu na gnod thub pa'i gtam gtong bar nges/ mgu na phan thogs nus pa cig gda'/ gser yig pa'i ngag la ma nyan na byas kyang dka' bar mthong*/

'dir mi gang drag pa dang 'dab nor khyer nas 'ong ba tsho bzang por btang bar gda'/ rang re tsho yang bzang po bya snyam pa'i bsam pa yod na/ nged rang gi dpon po kun 'dab nor bzang po bzung la sa skya pa'i mi dang 'grogs la byon/ 'dab nor 'di tsam zhig 'dab zer ba'i gros gyis/ 'dir ngas kyang gros byed/ de nas rang yul 'ongs nas rang gzhan thams cad la phan par 'ong*/ spyir ngas kyang na ning nas mi gtang nas 'di ltar byas na legs byas nas gros bstan pa/ khyed rang rnams kyis kyang de bzhin byed pa'i rigs su med pa 'dug brlag pa'i rjes la khyed tha dad tsho ci zer nyan pa cig 'dod pa yin nam/ ci zer ba yin yang ma go phyis sa skya pa hor gseb tu song ba yin te nged la ma phan zer ba de mi gsung bar zhu/ ngas bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i bsam pa byas nas/ bod skad smra ba thams cad la phan pa'i phyir du hor gseb tu 'ongs pa yin te/ da ci zer la nyan na phan par 'dug khyed rnams kyis 'di'i snang tshul ma mthong*/ thos pa rnams la yid ches pa shin tu dka'/ de'i stobs kyis da dung btub par 'ong snyam ste/ bde ba'i 'phro la glo bur du 'dres mnan pa lta bu'i thibs gnon cig byung nas dbus gtsang gi bu tsha dang mi la sogs pa hor gseb tu song gi dogs/ nged ni legs nyes ci byung yang nga la 'gyod pa med/ bla ma dkon mchog gi byin rlabs dang bka' drin gyis da dung legs po 'ong ba yang srid/ khyed rang rnams kyang dkon mchog la gsol ba thob/ rgyal pos nged la su dang yang mi 'dra ba'i thugs la btags/ de'i stobs kyis rgya bod/ yu gur/ mi nyag la sogs pa'i dge bshes mi chen/ yul mi gcig pa thams cad kyis ngo mtshar che snyam nas/ chos nyan pa dang gus pa che bar 'dug nged 'dir longs pa rnams la hor gyis ci 'dra byed snyam pa'i dogs pa mi dgos/ thams cad kyis thugs la btags nas bzang por yod pas/ nged kyi phyogs nas thams cad blo bde bar bzhugs pas chog

'dab nor la gser/ dngul/ glang po che'i mche ba/ mu tig rdog po che ba/ mtshal/ btsod/ ru rta/ gi wang*/ stag gzigs gung gsum/ sram/ bod snam/ dbus phrugs bzang po/ 'di na de tsho dga' bar 'dug spyir nor la 'dir nor rtsis chung yang*/ rang rang gi yul na gang bzang gi nor rdzas 'ong bas chog pa yin/ gser yod na gang 'dod 'ong bar 'dug pas dgongs mdzod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phyogs mtha' dag tu rgyas par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
